title: Works well, but could use more features
body:
Does what it’s supposed to, feels satisfying to log the habit and watch it disappear from your feed, but I wished there were some more features to help keep you more accountable for logging your habits. Features like a “Weekly Summary” notification that gives you detailed charts about how you‘re doing with your habits, as opposed to setting it and forgetting it, would be really beneficial and give habit logging more value to the user.

The biggest thing I hope gets implemented soon with this app is having an iPadOS and MacOS app version of it. Since it uses iCloud to backup your habits and data, it would really benefit from letting users backup, log, and track their habits from other devices as well (a la Habitify)

title: Great, but a few annoyances
body:
Really nicely designed with a great user interface. Easy and fun to use for tracking and breaking habits. Also love the updates to the journal – it’s so much easier to use now.

I use it to track my visits to the gym and it would be great if I exceed my weekly goal that I get a little star for the week (for example if my goal is 4 and I do 5) or some kind of celebration or marker for you having gone above and beyond. 

It’s very annoying that it’s constantly asking to backup to the cloud with options to remind again tomorrow or in 5 days. How about never? I don’t want to backup to the cloud.

Otherwise I love it! So simple and elegant!
